stochastic_seed_policy: Per-experiment seeds must be frozen in experiment identity; CI does not claim a global RNG seed for all research code.
offline_install_protocol: Export the dev environment from uv.lock and compare it with requirements-lock.txt.
Download hash-verified binary wheels for the current OS and Python ABI.
Build the pure-Python project wheel using the locked setuptools and wheel packages.
Create a fresh virtual environment and install dependencies with pip --no-index --find-links.
Install the project wheel locally, run pip check, and import the installed package.
blockers: Ubuntu and Windows CI must pass the fresh offline wheelhouse installation before reproducibility is marked verified.
